'''''Pericallis''''' is a small [[genus]] of 15 [[species]] of [[flowering plant]]s in the family [[Asteraceae]], native to the [[Canary Islands]], [[Madeira]] and [[Azores]]. The genus includes [[herbaceous]] plants and small [[subshrub]]s. In the past, the genus was often included in either ''[[Cineraria]]'' or ''[[Senecio]]''.

The florist's cineraria ([[Pericallis × hybrida|''Pericallis'' × ''hybrida'']]) is a [[Hybrid (biology)|hybrid]] between ''P. cruenta'' and ''P. lanata''.<ref name=powo>{{cite web | work=Plants of the World Online |title=Pericallis x hybrida (Bosse) B.Nord. |publisher=Royal botanic Gardens, Kew |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:1164364-2 |access-date=26 May 2023 }}</ref>
